branding.title: Logo and Branding
branding.logoDescription: The logo will appear on your quotes and invoices.
branding.acceptedFormats: Accepted formats: PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP

numbering.title: Document Numbering
numbering.warning: The next number is applied to the next document you create. Lowering it below an already-used number can create duplicate numbers. Change with care.

pos.title: Point of Sale
pos.autoPrintReceipt: Automatically print receipt after each sale
pos.showStockWarning: Show a warning when stock is low

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.description: Configure the stamp duty (droit de timbre) applied to cash payments for tax reporting.
taxes.stampDutyEnabled: Apply stamp duty on cash payments
taxes.stampDutyScaleNote: Stamp duty follows the legal progressive scale (1% / 1.5% / 2% by amount, 5 DA minimum), applied automatically to cash-settled sales.

documents.title: PDF documents
documents.printBundleDetail: Show pack contents on quotes and invoices
documents.printBundleDetailHint: Unchecked, a pack takes a single line. Its contents are still printed when its components carry different VAT rates, and always on delivery notes.

dashboardCustomization.title: Dashboard Layout
dashboardCustomization.description: Choose which stat cards appear on your dashboard and reorder them. Saved on this device.

legal.title: Legal Information
legal.legalMentionsPlaceholder: Legal mentions to display on documents...
legal.legalMentionsHint: The mandatory mentions of your tax regime are added to invoices automatically. Use this field for your own (insurance, approved association…).
legal.vatFranchiseHint: Your invoices will read "TVA non applicable, article 293 B du CGI".
legal.b2bHint: Printed on invoices to business clients, with the €40 fixed compensation for recovery costs.
legal.vatOnDebits: Option to pay VAT on debits
legal.vatOnDebitsHint: Tick only if you opted for it with the tax office: the mention will be printed on your service invoices.

messages.deleteLogoConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the logo?

backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.exportDescription: Download a full backup of your data. Encrypted backups are protected with AES-256 encryption.
backup.includePhotosHint: Photos make the backup much larger. Leave this off unless you need them restored.
backup.exportEncryptedHint: Only the encrypted export includes user accounts' passwords, so deleted users can be fully restored. A restore never changes an existing user's password.
backup.passwordRequired: Password is required for encrypted backups
backup.importFailed: Failed to import backup. Check your password.
backup.importDescription: Select an encrypted .enc backup file and enter the password used during export.
backup.importConfirmMessage: This will replace all your existing data. This action cannot be undone. Are you sure?

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.description: Add an extra layer of security to your account.
twoFactor.setupDescription: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the key manually.
twoFactor.verifyCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your app
twoFactor.backupCodesDescription: Save these codes in a safe place. Each can only be used once.

sessions.title: Active Sessions
sessions.revokeAllConfirm: Are you sure? This will log you out of all other devices.

legalCompliance.title: Invoice compliance
legalCompliance.ok: Everything the law requires on your invoices is filled in.
legalCompliance.missing: Some information the law requires on your invoices is missing:

issues.clientActivity: the nature of the client's activity
issues.invoiceExemptionGround: the exemption ground for 0% lines (state it in the notes, e.g. "Autoliquidation")
issues.invoiceVatUnderFranchise: some lines carry VAT although you are under the VAT franchise (set them to 0%)
issues.invoiceOperationNature: the nature of the operations (goods, services or both)
issues.clientSiren: the business client's SIREN number (mandatory for SMEs from 1 September 2027)

legalCompliance.invoiceTitle: This invoice is not compliant yet

posCompliance.title: Secured cash journal
posCompliance.description: Every till sale, cancellation, refund and invoice payment is sealed in a chained, unalterable journal, closed every day, month and year (article 286 of the French tax code: inalterability, security, retention, archiving).
posCompliance.chainBroken: The journal was altered from record no. {{sequence}}. Contact support.
posCompliance.archiveHint: Download the signed archive of a finished month or year, in open JSON format with its notice in French. Keep it for six years.
posCompliance.archiveEmpty: Nothing was recorded in this period.
posCompliance.archiveNotFinished: Only a finished period can be archived.
posCompliance.archiveFailed: The archive could not be generated.
posCompliance.attestationHint: Individual attestation that the cash software complies (model BOI-LETTRE-000242). Complete and sign part 2, then keep it for an audit.
posCompliance.attestationUnavailable: The attestation is not available yet: the publisher has not filled in its identity.
posCompliance.attestationFailed: The attestation could not be generated.
